Gold: no known drug allergies. Generated allergy-002: no medication allergies (aligned with gold), but allergy-001 adds a peanut allergy; while food vs drug allergy differs, the gold explicitly states none to drugs and does not mention peanuts. The existence of an allergy is additional, not opposite to 'no drug allergies', but overall allergy profile differs. Since gold is limited to drug allergies, the core gold statement (no drug allergies) is actually supported by allergy-002; thus not contradicted. However, the presence of peanut allergy does not negate no drug allergies. So this gold fact is COVERED by allergy-002. (Reclassification for precision.)
